theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_fd_cauchy_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (L : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact L → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ j, ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ R.support ⊆ L ∧ X j - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ ε) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ R.support ⊆ L ∧ X (φ (r + 1)) - X (φ r) - S = R.boundary ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
